name: zcode-beautify-workbuddy
description: 壁纸美化 WorkBuddy 桌面客户端:导入图片 / 视频 / Wallpaper Engine 场景壁纸作为无缝循环背景,并用 Material Design 3(莫奈取色)动态配色适配整个 UI,附带可拖拽的实时设置面板。
description_en: Beautify the WorkBuddy desktop client: import an image, video or Wallpaper Engine scene wallpaper as a seamless looping background, adapt the whole UI with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune everything from a draggable live settings panel.
